physics._doc: E008/E009-informed v3 ensemble. Forcing = SMOC uo+utide with SEPARATE Stokes (vsdx/vsdy), so windage must exclude wave drift: 0.02 + Stokes ~ 3.5% total (Roehrs et al. 2018 Ocean Sci 14:1581; OpenDrift default 0.02). Frozen 0.03/0.04 + Stokes likely double counts (E000 item 4).
physics.model: OceanDrift transport-only (weathering irreversible; Breivik et al. 2012 BAKTRAK)
physics._diffusivity_why: Okubo 1971 apparent diffusivity 0.2-3 m2/s at 6-48 h; MEDSLIK-II default 2, calibrated 2-13 m2/s (Accarino et al. 2025); OpenDrift example 10

forecast._doc: Forward forecast T0 -> T0+72 h with weathering (OpenOil, NOAA weathering), GSHHG coastline stranding, v3 transport ensemble. Forcing covers to 2023-01-07 06:00 (T0+78 h).
forecast._sst_why: ASSUMPTION: offshore northern Gulf of Mexico SST in early January ~21-23 C (NOAA climatology); no SST in the incident forcing. OpenOil default (10 C) would under-evaporate.
forecast._m3_why: volume unknown from SAR; mass fractions (fate shares) are reported, not absolute volumes
